raw.query: SELECT d.window_name, d.policy, d.lead_s, c.p99_ms FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.cost_accounting c ON d.window_name = c.window_name AND d.policy = c.policy AND d.lead_s = c.lead_s WHERE d.window_name = 'burst3' AND d.policy = 'reactive' AND d.is_current = true ORDER BY d.lead_s;
raw.claimed: The reactive controller on the same signal loses the fastest-onset burst at every lead.
raw.evidence: At all tested leads (15 to 165 seconds), the reactive policy on the fastest-onset burst (burst3) has p99 encoder delays ranging from 9.5 s to 54.2 s, which vastly exceeds the 1 s SLA bound.
